title: Work tape contents under lifting
statement: Let $e: ool	o	ext{Γ}$ be an injective map, and let $x$ be a finite string over $	ext{Γ}$ and $x'$ a finite Boolean string of the same length. For configurations $D$ on $x$ and $c$ on $x'$, and for each work tape $j$ and integer tape position $p$, the symbol stored at $(j,p)$ in the configuration obtained by lifting $c$ over $D$ equals $D$'s symbol there if $c$'s symbol there equals the Boolean decoding of $D$'s symbol; otherwise it is the image under $e$ of $c$'s symbol, with blank cells remaining blank under this image.
hypotheses_covered: An injective map from Boolean symbols to symbols in Γ
Strings x and x′ have equal lengths
Configurations D on x and c on x′
